messages:
Noor (Sales): Quick handoff — PharmAssist signed MSA overnight. Contacts: Dr. Chen (CTO) & Luca (Platform). They require private VPC peering + Okta/SCIM and want Dedicated capacity ~4 weeks out. Baseline ~1.6M tokens/mo, bursts to ~3.8M. Procurement is slow in their org; please flag renewal-watch if PO delayed >30 days. Passing to CS for onboarding, Eng for infra precheck, Support for runbook.

Ivy (CS): Taking point. I will schedule a 30m technical kickoff. Need billing contact, top 3 API flows (happy path + 1-2 failure cases), any PHI handling notes, and sample prompts. Also want to capture success criteria for 30/60 day adoption.

Noor (Sales): Billing contact is Liam (RevOps) cc'd. Top flows: 1) clinical-chat (low latency, short-turn) 2) nightly bulk embeddings for search 3) webhook classifier. Failure case: long-running embedding jobs causing memory pressure. Prompts here: https://drive.redwood/pharmassist-samples. Model: redwood/med-l7b-quant, checkpoint ~9.4GB after quant. Seq len typical 512, batch jobs up to 2048.

Samir (Eng): I can do VPC/peering + SSO feasibility check. ETA: 3 business days. Need test CIDR, allowed egress ports, and infra contact (Luca). Ill include GPU sizing and a recommended canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 3 days. If dedicated not ready day-1, fallback to hosted compat model.

Bea (Support): Ill draft the runbook: monitoring alerts, throttles, escalation matrix, and onboarding playbook. Starting alerts:
```
alerts:
  - p95_latency > 400ms
  - 5xx_rate > 0.75%
fallback: redwood/hosted-compat-model
rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%
```
Will post v1 in the shared kickoff doc by Monday. Planning a runbook drill with their oncall in week 2.

Liam (RevOps): Ill push the PO lane and requested SOC2 + DPA. PO ETA ~3 weeks but Ill flag renewal-watch if >30 days. Noted PHI-adjacent ask  will surface any contract items.

scheduler-bot: Kickoff created: Tue 9:00am PT "PharmAssist onboarding intake" (invitees: Noor, Ivy, Samir, Bea, Dr. Chen).

Ivy (CS): Summarizing owners & next steps I'll paste into the kickoff doc:
- Owners: Ivy (CS lead), Samir (Eng precheck), Bea (Support runbook), Liam (RevOps billing), Noor (Sales)
- Deliverables: infra precheck (3bd), runbook v1 (3bd), kickoff Tue 9am PT
- Success criteria: p95_chat <400ms, 5xx <0.75%, PO in 30 days or escalate to AM/RevOps
- Enablement: week-2 runbook drill, 30-day feedback + small NPS check

Bea (Support): Added "what to log" snippet (trace_id, model_id, latency_ms) to the kickoff doc to speed triage. Ill attach the runbook link after v1.

Ivy (CS): Thanks all  Ill update this thread after kickoff with the finalized runbook and onboarding checklist. If PO slips past 30d Liam please tag renewal-watch and loop AM. :thumbsup:
